draft.text: You came in because you hurt your right index finger while skiing on Saturday.
You have sharp, aching pain on the tip of your finger that gets worse when you move, touch, or grip it.
You have a recent injury to your right index finger that is causing pain and stiffness.
We will talk about ways to manage your pain and may give you medicine to help with the pain and swelling.
If needed, you may be referred to a specialist for more evaluation and treatment.
